greeting: Hello, thank you for calling Glow Salon. I'm the virtual assistant and I can book an appointment for you. What would you like to book?
consent_notice: This call is handled by an AI assistant and the conversation is recorded to complete your request. Please use demo details only.
escalation_message: No problem. I'm passing your request to our salon staff, and someone will call you back shortly. Thank you!

fields.name: customer_name
fields.label: Customer name
fields.prompt: Ask for the customer's full name.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Mobile number
fields.prompt: Ask for a 10-digit Indian mobile number.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Appointment date
fields.prompt: Ask for the appointment date; it cannot be in the past.

fields.name: time
fields.label: Appointment time
fields.prompt: Ask for a time between 10 AM and 8 PM.
